name: 15424 · Confluence, PA
findings: ZIP 15424 (Confluence) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (75% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15424 (Confluence) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
